campaign-courtyard.alt: A campaign frame shot in a colonnaded stone courtyard: arched bays, clipped olive trees in terracotta pots and a low fountain, with the model in a rust silk blouse and an ivory block-printed skirt.

campaign-interior.alt: A campaign frame in a panelled interior: a gilt mirror and a wall sconce behind the model, who stands in window light in a rust halter and the same ivory printed skirt, looking up and away.

campaign-amber.alt: The amber button-through top over a chocolate bias skirt, on a seamless ivory ground, a diagonal patch of window light falling across the floor behind her.

campaign-peach.alt: The peach art-deco dress with embroidered bell sleeves, one sleeve lifted to show the fall, full length on a warm seamless ground.

campaign-rose.alt: The rose-gold mandarin-collar top over an ivory bias skirt, on a warm seamless ground - the palette's dusty rose and warm ivory worn together.

contents.alt: The contents page of the Possah brand guidelines: eleven numbered sections from Brand Story to Tone of Voice, with page numbers, set beside the four taglines.

logo.alt: The Possah lockup: a hand-drawn diamond symbol in a warm orange-to-gold gradient beside the wordmark THE POSSAH with HAUTE COUTURE set beneath it.

logo-discipline.alt: Logo construction and clear space, drawn on a grid: symbol height is 1X, the gap between symbol and wordmark 0.5X, the gap between the serif and sans lines 0.25X, and the exclusion zone on every side is half the symbol height.

palette.alt: The Possah colour palette: Dusty Rose Pink, Deep Forest Green and Warm Ivory as primaries, Burnt Orange and Muted Mustard Gold as accents, each with its hex and RGB values.

typography.alt: The Possah type specification on a forest-green ground: three families — a hand-drawn display sans, a grotesque for body and a monospace accent — with a weight spectrum, a seven-step scale from 72pt display to a 9pt label, and the tracking, leading and minimum size rules.

ratios.alt: The colour ratio page: a bar divided 60 per cent warm ivory, 30 per cent deep forest green and 10 per cent accent, shown applied to a web hero, an Instagram post and a packaging panel, under the line "Restraint is the brand. Accent should feel earned, never decorative."

scale.alt: The sizing page: the lockup drawn at four sizes with a measuring rule under each - large for print and signage at a minimum of 60 millimetres, medium for lookbook and packaging at 35, small for a business card or hangtag at 20, and minimum digital for an Instagram avatar or favicon at 24 pixels - then the symbol alone at avatar, favicon and app-icon sizes, with the instruction to pixel-snap it to the grid and never render it below 24 pixels or use the full lockup at favicon scale.

patterns.alt: The pattern system: three tessellations drawn from the brand mark - Pattern A in dusty rose on ivory for tissue paper, Pattern B in deep forest green for lookbook endpapers, and Pattern C in the orange-to-gold gradient for the hero campaign band - under the line "Inspired by the brand mark, repeated as a quiet textile rhythm - never overpowering."

icons.alt: Sixteen hairline icons on a 24-pixel grid — atelier, drape, fit, tailoring, embroidery, fabric, hanger, garment bag, shipping, care, iron, hand-wash, concierge, appointment, gift and sustainability — for product care, web interface and packaging callouts.

moodboard.alt: The moodboard: draped silk and handloom in rose, ivory and gold, close detail of gold embroidery on forest green, light through a jali screen, and marigolds beside a swatch of burnt orange.

naming.alt: Taglines and naming: the master line "she wants what she wants." with three supporting lines; the collection convention POSSAH, season, year, theme word, worked through as Spring 26 Veil, Festive 26 Ember and Resort 27 Drift; and four sub-lines — The Atelier for couture, The Edit for ready-to-wear, The Drape for sarees, The Vault for archive.

stationery.alt: The stationery suite photographed as a flat lay: letterhead, a founder's card in forest green, an invoice, a note card reading "she wants what she wants", and an envelope closed with a green wax seal, with a brass seal stamp and marigolds alongside.

packaging.alt: The packaging system: a forest-green carrier bag with rope handles, a box lined with rose-pink patterned tissue and closed with a green band, a drawstring dust bag, swing tags and a card.

atelier.alt: The atelier interior: rails of rose and ivory garments under a tall mirror, a forest-green velvet bench, terracotta floor, and the mark etched into a frosted glass door.

web.alt: The homepage concept: a full-width campaign image carrying "she wants what she wants" over it, a line of supporting copy, a three-piece edit with names and prices, and a made-to-measure panel on forest green.

web-mobile.alt: The same homepage on a phone: the campaign image and tagline, the supporting line beneath it, and the edit reflowed to two across.

instagram.alt: The Instagram feed designed as a grid: campaign photography alternating with typographic tiles carrying the master tagline, a burnt-orange panel and a forest-green panel reading "haute couture".

reels.alt: Three reel covers — The Drape Series, Behind the Stitch, and She Wears Possah — each a campaign still with the title set over it and the mark at the foot.
